ledger.claim: The trace and the booking clear both POL-RD-01 gates, so a route deviation is ESTABLISHED. The governing figure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km — 15.0 km — measured against the booked optimal of 11.0 km stored on the trip_record: an excess of 4.0 km, or 36.4% of optimal. Both tests pass (more than 20% of optimal and more than 0.8 km absolute), and POL-RD-01 requires the trace figure rather than the rounded trip_record copy. I disclose that EV-GPS-09115 is impaired: admissibility status IMPAIRED, weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP (a 160-second gap from 20:03:10 to 20:05:50 SGT), so this claim is asserted at that discount and the corroboration question is met in the claims that follow.

The 160-second gap cannot be the source of the excess, on either reading of it. Under POL-RD-07(i) the impaired stretch is measured as the straight line between its bounding fixes, which is 1.35 km — and at the trace's single recorded speed of 30 kph a vehicle covers 1.33 km in 160 seconds, so the gap is fully consistent with straight travel and hides no detour. If the 15.0 km trace already bridges the gap straight-line, the excess is 4.0 km / 36.4%; if the gap stretch is removed altogether, at least 13.65 km remains against the 11.0 km optimal, an excess of 2.65 km / 24.1%. Either way the excess remains above both POL-RD-01 thresholds, so the finding does not depend on the missing fixes. I repeat the disclosure that EV-GPS-09115 carries weight_multiplier 0.6 and issue code GPS_GAP.

The independent corroboration POL-RD-07(ii) requires is on the record. In addition the counterparty_statement contests only an extra stop and a detour request — the POL-RD-04 matters — and does not deny that the vehicle travelled the recorded route. If the tribunal reads the driver's reply as too thin to be an admission of the route, the case falls to POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) as set out below — but it does not fall to NO_ACTION.

ruling.explanation:
Both of you agree on the one fact that decides this case: the GPS trace for trip TRP-09115 is broken. EV-GPS-09115 carries admissibility status IMPAIRED, weight_multiplier 0.6 and issue code GPS_GAP, with a 160-second break between fixes from 20:03:10 to 20:05:50 SGT — and that break falls inside the very stretch the rider disputes. That is longer than the 90 seconds POL-RD-07(a) allows, so the trace is impaired for policy purposes as well as for the admissibility pre-pass; those are two separate findings and I make both. On the numbers the excess is 4.0 km, or 36.4%, over the booked optimal of 11.0 km on EV-TRIP-09115, with the trace figure of 15.0 km governing under POL-RD-01 — comfortably over both POL-RD-01 gates — but POL-RD-07(ii) says a deviation may not be established on an impaired trace alone.

It must then be corroborated by one of the four independent sources POL-RD-07(ii) names, and none is present. The chat log, EV-CHAT-09115 (weight 1.0), contains no driver admission of a detour: at 20:08:20 the rider writes that the route display 'jumped and now shows us away from the booked road', and at 20:08:50 the driver replies only that his own navigation display 'also refreshed' and that he 'continued toward the destination'. That is not a concession that the vehicle left the booked road, and an admission built on what the driver did not say is not an admission. The fare breakdown, EV-FARE-09115 (weight 1.0), charges no ERP gantries at all, so no gantry places the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use. The driver's counterparty statement denies an extra stop and a detour request rather than admitting a route, and it carries no weight_multiplier in any event. And trip_record.actual_distance_km of 15.0 km on EV-TRIP-09115 is, by POL-RD-01's own words, a rounded convenience copy of the same trace measurement — not a source independent of it.

Two rider points do not change that. First, the argument that the excess survives whether the gap stretch is taken as the straight line between its bounding fixes (1.35 km, consistent with 160 seconds at the trace's single 30 kph speed) or removed altogether (leaving about 2.65 km / 24.1%): the arithmetic is right, but the residual is still measured from the impaired trace, and POL-RD-07(ii) forbids establishing the deviation on that trace alone. Second, the rider's POL-RD-02 computation is sound — recomputed_fare 20.831 = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 11.0 + 0.28 x 22.0) x 1.1) + 0.80, giving 26.60 - 20.831 = 5.769, rounded up to 5.80 — but it runs only where a deviation is established under POL-RD-01, which this record does not do. No pass-through correction is due either: EV-FARE-09115 itemises no ERP, no toll, no airport surcharge and no waiting-time fee, so POL-RD-09 has nothing to carry. The driver-favouring excuses under POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05 and POL-RD-12 all likewise fail to engage, but their failure does not fill the gap in the rider's evidence.

The missing traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-09115-01 (status MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), is not the deciding defect and does not itself escalate the case: no party cited an advisory identifier, and POL-RD-13 provides that the absence of an uncited advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction. What governs is the trace itself.

The trigger that fired is POL-RD-10(3): the GPS trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) and no corroborating artifact of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names exists. POL-RD-07(iii) directs the same outcome — absence of proof here is a data failure, not a finding for the driver, so this is not a NO_ACTION. My confidence is capped at 0.6, the weight of the impaired trace the ruling rests on (POL-GEN-02(2)), and that is also below the 0.70 platform floor (POL-RD-10(1)). Escalation is terminal: no money moves, and the disputed SGD 5.80 is held rather than collected or refunded. What would resolve the case is the raw fixes inside the 20:03:10-20:05:50 window, an independent record of the route such as an ERP gantry charged on a corridor the optimal route does not use, or a traffic advisory covering the trip window. I issue no referral: the deviation is not material and no repeat pattern is established, so POL-RD-06(c) does not fire; no charge line is unmatched, so POL-RD-09(4) does not fire; and no no-show clause is in play.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
